accepted_baseline.mutation_rule: The accepted v0.2.1 archive is historical read-only evidence. This audit neither modifies nor repackages it.

selected_learner.release_status: No software tag is used; the exact Git commit is the source authority.

candidate_admission_rule.action_completeness: Every action in the frozen candidate-independent boundary yields a deterministic next result or an explicit deterministic unsupported/error result.
candidate_admission_rule.behavioral_deduplication: Retain the earliest-provenance candidate for each distinct finite trace signature. Source or checkpoint identity alone does not make a behavioral candidate.
candidate_admission_rule.complete_bytes_and_provenance: Candidate source, static data, helper files, creation point, source commit, run identity, upstream artifact checksum, local SHA-256, dependency envelope, and licenses are recorded.
candidate_admission_rule.determinism: For PYTHONHASHSEED values 0, 1, 5, and 10, run every frozen deduplication word twice in fresh processes; canonical traces must be byte-identical.
candidate_admission_rule.offline_execution: After extraction, candidate execution occurs in fresh local processes with network disabled and no LLM, hosted service, credential, hidden conversation, or external memory.
candidate_admission_rule.prefix_replay: Initial reconstruction and rendering exactly reproduce the frozen final settled P0 frame and declared status/level metadata.
candidate_admission_rule.reset: Every word starts from a fresh immutable process or documented local reset that deterministically reconstructs P0 without ARC or service calls.
candidate_admission_rule.source_blindness_audit: Inspect mounts, source tree access, network/web traces, scorecards, prior-run files, and game aliases. Unexplained game-source or web access blocks admission.
candidate_admission_rule.state_initialization: Initialize only from the frozen P0 evidence and checkpoint-contained files. Reject dependence on later observations, unreleased state, hosted thread state, or mutable files outside the bundle.

candidate_enumeration_order: Final executable world-model bundle from each selected run.
Exact iteration_N Git commits/tags retained inside each run workspace.
Explicit immutable checkpoint/snapshot directories retained by the release.
candidate_sources.no_reconstruction_rule: Do not reconstruct missing candidate files from narrative logs, LLM transcripts, diffs, or game outcomes. Candidate bytes and dependency closure must be released.
candidate_sources.sampling_interpretation: Different checkpoints or runs of the same learner are separately sampled candidates, not independently authored learners.

claim_boundary: Track A opened instrument feasibility only. No sealed confirmation, evaluator-private identification, necessary ontology-revision claim, decision superiority, global equivalence, or Track B claim.

frozen_finite_behavior_boundary.action6_words: If ACTION6 is available, expand its official finite x,y domain 0..63 by 0..63 and enumerate every one-step ACTION6(x,y) plus every one-step simple action. Do not enumerate longer ACTION6 words in 003a.
frozen_finite_behavior_boundary.action_source: Use the byte-identical P0 available-actions metadata, not candidate predictions.
frozen_finite_behavior_boundary.non_equivalence_endpoint: At least one frozen word produces different canonical traces from the same P0.
frozen_finite_behavior_boundary.non_separation_wording: No divergence within the frozen finite boundary. Never describe this as global equivalence or impossibility.
frozen_finite_behavior_boundary.output_signature: At each predicted step record final settled frame SHA-256, predicted status, predicted level/progress fields if modeled, and deterministic error category. Preserve any candidate-emitted intermediate frames separately but do not require them because the selected source verifier does not.
frozen_finite_behavior_boundary.purpose: Acquisition-level behavioral deduplication only. This is not the full ARC adapter, an OIA separator run, or a global equivalence test.
frozen_finite_behavior_boundary.reset_handling: RESET is an initialization operation and is not part of the deduplication alphabet.
frozen_finite_behavior_boundary.simple_action_words: If the admitted alphabet has at most eight non-parameterized actions and excludes ACTION6, enumerate all words of lengths 1 through 3.

opened_environment.required_version_check_after_acquisition: The full game identifier/version and P0 bytes must match across candidate sources. A slug match alone is insufficient.
selection_basis: The official toolkit uses ls20 as a public quickstart environment.
The selected learner publishes completed ls20 result rows for both GPT-5.6-sol max and xhigh runs.
The released run family is reported to include executable workspaces and per-iteration snapshots.

canonicalization.candidate_replay_boundary: Because the selected learner executable interface verifies the final settled frame and status, candidate admission requires exact initial-state rendering of the final settled P0 frame and exact status/level metadata. No animation-modeling claim is made.
canonicalization.envelope: Canonical JSON UTF-8, sorted object keys, compact separators, integers preserved exactly, no NaN.
canonicalization.frames: Preserve every returned frame in original order in the evidence registry.

opened_prefix.definition: The complete ordered initial observation packet immediately after reset and before the first environment action, as released inside each selected run.
opened_prefix.identity_requirement: The canonical P0 packet, full game identifier/version, level index, available-actions metadata, state/status, and final settled frame must be byte-identical across all admitted candidate sources.
opened_prefix.rationale: A zero-action prefix makes the two released runs eligible for one identical opened starting point without executing or selecting a new real ARC action.

scope.authorized: Public-source and released-artifact inspection plus local, non-mutating candidate-acquisition checks for one source-blind executable-world-model learner on one public ARC-AGI-3 environment.

selected_released_artifact.expected_content_scope: Exploratory ewma_sv_v1.6 GPT-5.6-sol max and xhigh run artifacts, including generated workspaces/world models.

stop_rule.before_download: Because the selected archive is a 797,835,543-byte compressed object requiring multi-gigabyte temporary extraction, stop with resource_authorization_required before download under the current prompt.
stop_rule.before_real_or_paid_work: No paid/API/model run, credential request, or real ARC action may occur under 003a.
